svg.aria-label: Badges: C4 + E4, major third, 4 semitones, 3 letters; E4 + G4, minor third, 3 semitones, 3 letters; C4 + F4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones, 4 letters; B3 + E4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones, 4 letters; D4 + E4, major second, 2 semitones, 2 letters; B3 + F4, diminished fifth, 6 semitones, 5 letters; D4 + F4, minor third, 3 semitones, 3 letters.
svg.title: Pair badges used in Week 2

g.text: One badge for every named pair
How to read this graphic: Read each badge
from the top: interval name and short symbol,
then the two notes with their octave numbers,
then the two counts. The colour bar belongs
to the whole pair. Two badges can share a
colour (C4 + F4 and B3 + E4 are both perfect
